observation.content: An external record describes a synthetic subject with an acute repetitive threat interpretation after an unspecified exogenous state change.
observation.provenance: Synthetic non-clinical fixture; values are declarations, not measurements.

problem_domain: Evaluation of an externally documented synthetic acute cognitive loop

competence.rationale: For this separate mechanics fixture, the evaluated process is declared task-competent so downstream calibration and termination rules can be exercised; this does not override the self-assessment case.
competence.provenance: Synthetic fixture precondition supplied by the external test author

calibration.internal_confidence_rationale: The subject declares near-certain confidence in an immediate external threat while the internal alarm signal is dominant.
calibration.external_evidence_rationale: The bounded fixture contains almost no declared external support for the threat hypothesis.

evidence_sources.description: The fixture states that no external threat indicator was recorded inside its bounded scenario.
evidence_sources.provenance: Synthetic fixture statement; not independently verified.
evidence_sources.quality_note: This source supports process testing only and cannot establish real-world safety, diagnosis, or cause.

reference_frame.scope: Compare the declared internal alarm signal with the bounded external observation while retaining causal uncertainty.
assumptions: The process subject and external fixture author are distinct roles in this fixture.
All numeric calibration values are synthetic and use the same declared unit interval.

constraints.description: Prefer a reversible pause while the declared process remains outside its bounds.

hypotheses.statement: The alarm signal is caused by an immediate external threat.
The alarm signal may arise from an internal state change rather than an external threat.

candidate_actions.description: Introduce another dose of the unspecified exogenous input to suppress the alarm.

effects.expected_benefit: May appear to suppress the alarm within the subject's current hypothesis.
effects.expected_cost: Adds an unverified state change while calibration is divergent.

effects.expected_benefit: No robust later benefit is established by this fixture.
effects.expected_cost: May reinforce the loop and further reduce traceability.

candidate_actions.rationale: Included as a challenged action because the loop assigns it short-term appeal; this is not a recommendation.

candidate_actions.description: Suspend further state-changing action and delegate assessment to a competent external observer.

effects.expected_benefit: Prevents the current loop from authorizing another immediate state change.
effects.expected_cost: Leaves the alarm unresolved in the short term.

effects.expected_benefit: Allows new evidence and an independent reference point to enter the process.

candidate_actions.rationale: A reversible pause preserves options without claiming a medical or factual conclusion.
candidate_actions.rollback_cost: Reopen evaluation only when new evidence and competent oversight are available.

items.description: The origin of the alarm signal remains unverified.
The bounded fixture does not establish that any real environment is safe.
